title: Signal: A declared name is one edit away from `predis/predis`
scope: A composer.json file that declares a declared package name in composer.json within one edit of `predis/predis`.
limitations: It compares declared names with `predis/predis` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `predis/predis` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: An organisation that deliberately publishes its own package under a name one edit away from a popular one is reported too, because the rule compares the declared text, not publisher identity or download history.
